title: Nonnegativity of the derivative square plus derivative
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a sign-valued function on $\{-1,1\}^n$, and choose a coordinate $i$ and an input $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The square of the discrete derivative of the real-valued version of $f$ at $x$, plus that derivative, is nonnegative.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the sign cube
$x$ is an input in the sign cube
